name: Chia Hsin Cement Corporation
summary: Chia Hsin Cement Corporation manufactures and sells cement in Taiwan, China, and Japan. The company's activities include the wholesale and retail sale of building materials; non-metallic mining; manufacturing of ready-mixed concrete; international trade; leasing, construction, and development of residences and buildings, and industrial factory buildings; real estate commerce; and real estate rental and leasing. It is also involved in the reconstruction within the renewal area; warehousing and storage; healthcare; sports and training; manufacturing of beverages and bakery products; baking and steamed food manufacturing; hotel operation; and energy technology services.
